mapper.select: SELECT p.id,p.customer_id,p.status,p.release_status,p.shipment_required_amount, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(pay.amount) FROM bike_pi_payment pay WHERE pay.pi_id=p.id AND pay.status='CONFIRMED' FOR UPDATE),0) paid_amount FROM bike_pi p WHERE p.source_order_id=#{orderId} ORDER BY p.id FOR UPDATE

SELECT i.ordered_qty - ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bike_stock_out_record so JOIN bike_production_vehicle shipped ON shipped.vehicle_id=so.vehicle_id WHERE so.order_id=#{orderId} AND so.status='COMPLETED' AND shipped.sku_id=i.sku_id FOR UPDATE ) FROM bike_pi_item i JOIN bike_production_vehicle pv ON pv.sku_id=i.sku_id WHERE i.pi_id=#{piId} AND pv.vehicle_id=#{vehicleId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bike_pi WHERE source_order_id=#{orderId}
